metadata.question: Did nighttime brightness over Houston decrease on May 18, 2024, compared to April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) data for nighttime brightness - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" for monthly composites - Location: Houston, Texas (approximately 29.76°N, 95.37°W) - Dates: April 2024 (monthly composite) vs May 18, 2024 (need daily data) - Actually, for May 18 specifically, I should use daily data: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VCMSLCFG" - April 2024: Use monthly composite for the full month - May 18, 2024: Use daily composite 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want to measure brightness, not mask it - May need to filter for cloud-free pixels using QA bands - Focus on the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid decrease = April mean > May 18 mean (both valid numbers) - C1: No images found for either period - C2: After processing, no valid pixels remain - C3: Result is None/NaN or invalid range (negative radiance would be invalid) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.37, 29.76]); const region = houston.buffer(20000); // 20km radius around Houston // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // April 2024 - Monthly composite const april2024 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2024-04-01', '2024-05-01') .filterBounds(region); const aprilSize = april2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2024 Images: ${aprilSize}`); if (aprilSize === 0) { console.log("No data for April 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // May 18, 2024 - Daily composite const may18 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2024-05-01', '2024-06-01') .filterBounds(region); const maySize = may18.size().getInfo(); console.log(`May 2024 Images: ${maySize}`); if (maySize === 0) { console.log("No data for May 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing const aprilImg = april2024.first().select('avg_rad'); const mayImg = may18.first().select('avg_rad'); // Check pixel counts const aprilCount = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayCount = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`April valid pixels: ${aprilCount}`); console.log(`May valid pixels: ${mayCount}`); if (aprilCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation const aprilMean = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayMean = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`April 2024 mean radiance: ${aprilMean}`); console.log(`May 2024 mean radiance: ${mayMean}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (aprilMean === null || mayMean === null || isNaN(aprilMean) || isNaN(mayMean) || aprilMean < 0 || mayMean < 0) { console.log("Invalid radiance values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } const decrease = mayMean < aprilMean; const percentChange = ((mayMean - aprilMean) / aprilMean * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); console.log(`Decrease detected: ${decrease}`); if (decrease) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
